scope: Reviewed `src/orders` and `src/pricing`, the two folders with the most changes in the last 300 commits. The rest of the codebase was not reviewed.

candidates.title: Merge the order validation helpers into `OrderIntake.submit()`
candidates.problem: `OrderHandler` calls four helpers in a fixed order, and every route repeats that order. Adding a field to an order touches 5 files, and the tests mock 3 classes to check one rule.
candidates.change: Create `OrderIntake.submit(order)` that validates and saves in one call. Make the four helpers private to it and point the routes at `submit()`.
gains: A new order field touches 1 file instead of 5
Tests call `submit()` with SQLite instead of mocking 3 classes
Delete 4 exported helpers and 11 mock-heavy tests
Routes stop repeating the validation order

before.caption: Every route calls the helpers itself, in the right order.
before.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  R1[POST /orders] --> V[OrderValidator]
  R2[PUT /orders/:id] --> V
  V --> I[validateItems]
  V --> A[validateAddress]
  R1 --> Repo[OrderRepo]
  R2 --> Repo
  classDef problem stroke:#c62828,stroke-width:2px
  class R1,R2 problem

after.caption: Routes make one call; the order of checks lives inside.
after.mermaid:
flowchart TB
  R1[POST /orders] --> S[OrderIntake.submit]
  R2[PUT /orders/:id] --> S
  S --> I[validateItems]
  S --> A[validateAddress]
  S --> Repo[OrderRepo]
  classDef merged stroke:#16794a,stroke-width:3px
  class S merged

candidates.title: Pass a `PricingClient` into checkout instead of calling the pricing service directly
candidates.problem: `checkout.ts` and `refund.ts` each build their own HTTP calls to the pricing service, with copied retry logic. Their tests need a running pricing service.
candidates.change: Define a `PricingClient` interface with `quote()` and `refundQuote()`. Use the HTTP client in production and an in-memory fake in tests.
gains: Retry logic lives in one place
Checkout tests run without the pricing service
One file to change when the pricing API changes

before.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  C[checkout.ts] -- HTTP + retries --> P[(pricing service)]
  F[refund.ts] -- HTTP + retries --> P
  classDef problem stroke:#c62828,stroke-width:2px
  class C,F problem

after.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  C[checkout.ts] --> PC[PricingClient]
  F[refund.ts] --> PC
  PC --> H[HTTP client]
  PC -.tests.-> Fake[in-memory fake]
  H --> P[(pricing service)]
  classDef merged stroke:#16794a,stroke-width:3px
  class PC merged

candidates.adr_warning: Goes against ADR-0004 ("call internal services directly"), but worth reopening: the copied retry logic has already caused two incidents.

top.why: It removes the most repeated code in the folder that changes most, and the tests become simpler right away.
